text: Kidnappers demanded a ransom for the president’s daughter that was much larger than one million yen. He could not provide the full amount, so he made the bag look like it held the ransom: real notes covered bundles filled with ordinary paper. If the kidnappers checked and found only the original one million yen in genuine cash, they might attack. He added more genuine cash and made complete real bundles among the fake ones, increasing the chance that a bundle they inspected would pass as real long enough to protect his daughter.
